card.name: The phrase QT prolonging drugs
card.fires_on: The word ending "QT/QTc prolonging" (the "-ing" in prolonging, or "drugs" right after it) in drug interaction headings and sentences. Weaker on similar interaction phrases like co-administration or CYP3A inhibitors.

modes.label: QT prolonging drugs
modes.description: The end of the phrase QT or QTc prolonging, or the word drugs that follows it.
modes.example: Co-administration of DAURISMO with QTc prolong<<ing>> drugs may increase the risk of QTc
